dedupe_keys.name: shake table testing for system effects analysis in a 1 2 scale three story light frame timber building

description: Shake Table Testing for System Effects Analysis in a 1:2 Scale Three-Story Light Frame Timber Building is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Diego Valdivieso Cascante, Pontifical Catholic University of Chile (uc.cl). This study investigates the impact of system effects on the dynamic behavior of Light Frame Timber Buildings (LFTBs) through shake table tests and numerical analysis. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: light frame timber buildings, system effects, non-planar shear walls, transverse shear walls, out-of-plane bending stiffness of diaphragm. Published 2025-06-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
